texts.li: [their:tribal] A tale-seeker of {FACTION} has walked in from the hills with a staff notched for every story {X_pronoun} carries. {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that {X_pronoun} goes where the old stories are, and asked to sit at a fire {PLACE} for a few days.

[their:medieval] A scholar of {FACTION} has come up the track with a mule so laden with books it walks sideways. {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that {X_pronoun} has come a long way to see this land with {X_possessive} own eyes, and asked to camp {PLACE} a few days.

[their:industrial] A professor of {FACTION} has arrived with two students, a theodolite and a crate of notebooks. {X_nameDef} explained to {A_nameDef}, at some length, what their study is for, and asked whether they might camp {PLACE} for a few days.

[their:spacer] An archaeotech survey team of {FACTION} has set down its gear at the edge of the colony's land: scanners, sample cases and a drone that won't stop humming. {X_nameDef}, who leads it, asked {A_nameDef} for leave to camp {PLACE} a few days.

Scholars of {FACTION} have come a long way to a place most people never think about. {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} they mean to study and write while they're here, and asked to camp {PLACE} for a few days.

seekTexts.li: [seek:ruins] What they have come for is {SEEK}: nobody has written down who built them, and {X_nameDef} would like to be the first.
[seek:ruins,their:spacer] Their charts show {SEEK} as unsurveyed, and the team means to change that.
[seek:ruinRegion] They are on their way to {SEEK}, to see what is left of it before the weather takes the rest.
[seek:library] Word of {SEEK} had reached them on the road, and {X_nameDef} would dearly like an afternoon with them.
[seek:library,their:tribal] Word had reached {X_objective} that the colony keeps its stories in {SEEK}, and {X_pronoun} would like to see how that is done.
[seek:history] They came to hear {SEEK}, told by the people who lived it, before the tellings change.
[seek:history,their:tribal] {X_nameDef} has heard pieces of {SEEK} at other fires, and wants it whole.
[seek:wonder] They came to see {SEEK} and set it down properly, for the people at home who will never stand here.

settled.li: The scholars' camp {PLACE} is up: a table under an awning, weighted down with stones and papers, and a lamp to write by after dark.
The scholars from {FACTION} have made camp {PLACE}. The pack beast grazes, and the table is already covered in notes.
At the scholars' camp {PLACE}, a line of drying pages hangs between two stakes like washing.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef}, the scholars' youngest, has decided the colony is more interesting than anything in the notebooks, and asks to stay and write it down from the inside.
{X_nameDef} from the scholars' camp says {X_pronoun} has seen enough of the road and would rather teach than travel. {X_nameDef} asks whether the colony could use someone who reads.

farewell.li: The scholars from {FACTION} packed their notes in oilcloth and went on, arguing cheerfully about a date.
The scholars' camp {PLACE} is gone. Somewhere out on the road, the colony is becoming a chapter.
{X_nameDef} shook every hand at the gate, thanked the colony twice, and led the scholars off with the pack beast complaining behind them.

lines.li: I need a better word for it.

momentLines.li: [seek:ruins] Measure it again, from the corner.
[seek:ruins] Someone lived here, and liked the view.

helpTexts.li: [tales] {A_nameDef} sat up late at the scholars' fire while {X_nameDef} told of the old ruins and the people who built them, and came back with more questions than answers.
[tales,their:tribal] {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} three of the stories on {X_possessive} staff, one notch at a time, and asked for one of the colony's in return.
[book] {X_nameDef} carried a book of the scholars' to the colony's gate and left it there for the colony: {THING}, with a note inside the cover thanking its hosts.

li.label: Let them read in the colony's library

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} asks, very politely, whether the scholars might spend an afternoon with the colony's books. They will touch nothing they're not shown, and put everything back.
The scholars have heard the colony keeps books, and {X_nameDef} would like to read in its library for an afternoon. {X_pronoun} has offered to leave notes for whoever reads after.

li.tip: Two of the scholars read in the colony's library for an afternoon. Their notes in the margins help whatever the colony is studying now, a little.

outcomes.li: Two of the scholars will read in the colony's library this afternoon. {X_nameDef} has brought clean hands and a stack of paper for notes.
{X_nameDef} thanked {A_nameDef} warmly and went to fetch {X_possessive} reading glass.

refused.li: {X_nameDef} said the scholars quite understood, and went back to their own books.
The scholars stayed at their camp with the books they brought.

lines.li: Look at the binding on this.
Someone has read this one many times.
I'll put it back exactly where it was.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} tell them the colony's story

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} would like to hear the colony's story from someone who was there, and asks whether {A_nameDef} might sit with {X_objective} for an afternoon.
The scholars have come for the colony's story, and {X_nameDef} asks for an afternoon of {A_nameDef}'s time to write it down as {A_pronoun} tells it.

li.tip: One of the scholars sits with {A_nameDef} for an afternoon and writes down the colony's story as {A_pronoun} tells it. Practice in social skills, and the story goes into the colony's chronicle.

outcomes.li: {X_nameDef} will come to sit with {A_nameDef} this afternoon, with a fresh notebook and two pens in case one runs dry.
{A_nameDef} has agreed to tell the colony's story, and is already arguing with {A_objective}self about where it starts.

refused.li: {X_nameDef} said the story would keep, and asked only that nobody change it before {X_pronoun} comes back.

li.label: Have {A_nameDef} study with them
li.tip: {A_nameDef} spends a few hours at the scholars' table, copying and listening. Practice in intellectual work.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is at the scholars' table today, copying out {X_nameDef}'s notes and asking what half of them mean.
{X_nameDef} has taken {A_nameDef} through a chapter of {X_possessive} work, and set {A_objective} a question to answer by evening.
